title: Give the hunter gate's cast-off the Tcl checks' grace
message:
Give the hunter gate's cast-off the Tcl checks' grace

The gate stages its target at the Testing Dock. While the dock was missing
the hull launched at sea and undock was refused; now it launches berthed and
must cast off, which takes 30 seconds of vessel ticks. The gate allowed 33
seconds of wall clock, and on a loaded host the crew's report came two
seconds late, so the hull was still berthed when ordered to speed 2. Wait
43 seconds, the 33 plus the 10-second grace wait_for_game_output gives.

title: Package the harbor's west Testing Dock so the provisioner restores it
message:
Package the harbor's west Testing Dock so the provisioner restores it

Room 1000389, the Testing Dock at (-66, 92), lived only in the untracked
development world file and was lost when that file was replaced. Without it
the cell is shallow water, the ferry's west stop is not a seaport, and the
harbor provisioner's fare check fails. The harbor package now carries the
room beside the east dock, and the provisioner merges it back in.

title: Plan S-immediate and S9: the client and the play tests
message:
Plan S-immediate and S9: the client and the play tests

S9 plays the whole vessel system end to end in game through a real
client, with Kohdee staging Vesselmate and a second mortal, and records
screenshots and notes (guide-notes.md) for S10's player guide; every
defect found is fixed with a test. S-immediate comes first: it makes
sure the local Luminari Web has what S9 needs, checks it live, and adds
the Ship tab for the 21 vessel MSDP variables. S10, the guide itself,
joins the sequence.
